speaker: SECRETARY-GENERAL
text: The monitoring period has come to an end.

speaker: SECRETARY-GENERAL
text: The results show that the wind park is producing a significant amount of renewable energy for Arcadia, while the measures you introduced have substantially reduced its negative impacts.

speaker: FEATHERWINGS
text: The seasonal shutdowns have made a significant difference during the most sensitive migration periods. Bird activity around the wind park has improved.

speaker: AQUANAUTILUS
text: The use of suction buckets has greatly reduced underwater disturbance during construction. Marine life has been given a better chance to adapt to the new environment.

speaker: FISHERS GUILD
text: The artificial reefs have created new habitats for fish and other marine species. They have also created new opportunities for fishing communities.

speaker: PORT AUTHORITY
text: Moving the port has protected Arcadia's shipping connections and helped us maintain our competitive position.

speaker: LEGAL ADVISOR
text: Arcadia has not eliminated every impact of the wind park. That would be unrealistic.

speaker: LEGAL ADVISOR
text: Instead, the government has taken meaningful measures to prevent, reduce and manage those impacts.

speaker: SECRETARY-GENERAL
text: The wind park has shown us what sustainable infrastructure requires.

speaker: SECRETARY-GENERAL
text: Clean energy was only one part of the challenge. We also had to consider biodiversity, fishing communities, marine ecosystems and Arcadia's economy.

speaker: SECRETARY-GENERAL
text: You considered these interests together and chose measures that significantly reduced the project's negative consequences.

speaker: SECRETARY-GENERAL
text: Arcadia can now move forward with a wind park that contributes to our climate goals while respecting the people and ecosystems that depend on the Conan Sea.

speaker: SECRETARY-GENERAL
text: Your assignment is complete. You have successfully guided the project through its most difficult challenges.

speaker: SECRETARY-GENERAL
text: Your ship is waiting at the harbour. We wish you a safe journey home across the Conan Sea.
